ALT_OTS: A cinematic photographic espionage scene in a small records room beside a tall courtyard window. The portrait-guided woman compares physical photographic records with the space outside. Use the supplied portrait as facial and hair appearance guidance: a dark chin-length bob with fine separated bangs, the same facial proportions and natural features. She sits sideways at a wooden table in a charcoal cardigan over a pale open-collar shirt, her quiet appeal carried by attentive eyes and the soft window light on her cheek. An open dossier lies close to her on the tabletop. Its right page holds one large black-and-white contact sheet with four rectangular exposures separated by white gutters; the sheet has visible paper edges and two metal clips fastening it to the dossier page. The exposures show a courtyard with a distinctive iron gate and its diagonal crossbar. Her left fingertips rest on the lower white margin of the contact sheet, attached to a relaxed wrist and forearm supported by the table. Her right hand rests beside the closed cover. She has just raised her gaze from the records toward the courtyard. Through the window, the actual iron gate and diagonal crossbar stand beyond a real sill and the thickness of the wall; the visible courtyard is wet and still. An over-the-shoulder view from just behind her right shoulder shows her face in three-quarter profile beside the paper sheet and the actual window opening. The contact sheet spreads across the lower foreground, her shoulder anchors the near right edge, and the courtyard appears beyond her face at the top left. A small warm desk lamp separates the paper from the colder daylight; moderate depth of field keeps the sheet's image grid and the courtyard gate recognizable. Tactile paper, worn wood, soft skin texture and restrained colors create a tense moment of comparison.
